en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

New-product research and launch promotion: Organized consumer preferences, social feedback and competitor communication for ZUS Coffee products. Distilled selling points and campaign themes to support launch content planning.
Content production: Contributed to planning, shooting, editing and English copy for 50 Instagram posts, supporting publication, hashtags and promotional materials.

Retail communication and channel coordination: Supported FamilyMart retail communication and online launches by organizing store information, materials and schedules. Monitored content weekly and completed 15+ reviews to improve communication, contributing to 11k+ account follower growth.

Client coordination and campaign execution: Coordinated university demonstrations and trials, planned event flow, and worked with product and business teams on demos, FAQs and use cases. Organized on-site product introductions and Q&A, and consolidated feedback into 10 improvement suggestions for university pilots and future promotion.

Market research: Researched teaching, lesson preparation and self-study needs. Classified 100+ community feedback items by use case and experience barrier to inform product messaging, university communication and trial activities.

Communication planning and product promotion: Built a WeChat account from scratch and produced 30+ guides, FAQs and use cases around user needs. Explained product value through practical scenarios and developed reusable materials. Core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.
Channel partnerships: Supported Southeast Asia AI education partners by clarifying needs and responsibilities and following up on agreement signing and handoff.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

Campaign promotion: Supported acquisition plans using pricing surveys and user feedback to define audiences, product messages and campaign priorities. Independently designed selected online acquisition activities and supported materials, product introductions and on-site execution at technology events.
AI analysis: Created a lightweight AI-assisted marketing dashboard to identify drop-offs from reach to registration and inform channel adjustments and campaign reviews.

Brand content and creator promotion: Produced 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts about product value, use cases and common questions. Screened creators by audience fit and engagement, supported assets and publication follow-up, and checked copy and visuals for consistent brand and product information.

Channel mix and conversion: Combined online content, communities and offline activities. Tested titles, cover images and content, then adjusted channel budgets. Registrations during the campaign increased 50% versus the previous week; first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Master of Marketing candidate graduating in 2027; working English. Applying for pharmaceutical and health marketing, with experience in market research, product launches and client communication.
Marketing: research, campaign planning, product messaging, brand content, activity execution and channel partnerships.
AI: assisted copy and creative production, marketing dashboards and data analysis; campaign SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Reviews: Excel, SPSS and basic SQL; campaign monitoring, channel testing and performance reviews.
Content: WeChat, Xiaohongshu and Instagram; Canva, CapCut and basic Figma.
Collaboration: clients and partners, cross-functional coordination, activity planning and on-site Q&A; Feishu, DingTalk and Linear.
